CertIdentifier.description_en:
The global certificate ID, in the format of certificate ID + "-" + site region ID. This ID is commonly used across Alibaba Cloud services.
For Alibaba Cloud China Website (www.aliyun.com): certificate ID + "-cn-hangzhou"
For Alibaba Cloud International Website (www.alibabacloud.com): certificate ID + "-ap-southeast-1"

For example, if the certificate ID is 123, the CertIdentifier on Alibaba Cloud China Website (www.aliyun.com) is "123-cn-hangzhou", and the CertIdentifier on Alibaba Cloud International Website (www.alibabacloud.com) is "123-ap-southeast-1"
CertIdentifier.description_zh:
全局证书ID，格式为证书Id + "-" + 站点regionId，常用在阿里云各个云产品中。
国内站为证书Id + "-cn-hangzhou"
国际站为证书Id + "-ap-southeast-1"

例如证书Id = 123，则国内站CertIdentifier = “123-cn-hangzhou”，国际站CertIdentifier = "123-ap-southeast-1"
